name: Inquisitor Eisenhorn
oracle_text:
You may reveal the first card you draw each turn as you draw it. Whenever you reveal an instant or sorcery card this way, create Cherubael, a legendary 4/4 black Demon creature token with flying.
Whenever Inquisitor Eisenhorn deals combat damage to a player, investigate that many times. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
blocked_sentences: You may reveal the first card you draw each turn as you draw it. Whenever you reveal an instant or sorcery card this way, create Cherubael, a legendary 4/4 black Demon creature token with flying.

needs.what: an optional reveal of the first card a player draws each turn made at the moment it is drawn (the miracle-style reveal, granted by a permanent rather than printed on the drawn card), plus a 'card revealed this way' event carrying the revealed card so a trigger can filter it by type (instant or sorcery)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `draw` trigger with `max_per_turn`/`nth` and a type filter fires on the draw itself and its `reveal` op would happen only on resolution, so the reveal is no longer 'as you draw it' and the trigger is keyed on drawing rather than on choosing to reveal; the `miracle` rider is a card's own reveal and cannot be granted to the first draw of any card

needs.what: Cherubael, a legendary 4/4 black Demon creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has only demon_x_x_b_flying (a nonlegendary X/X Demon) and vampire_demon_4_3_wb_flying (a white-black 4/3 Vampire Demon); neither is a named legendary 4/4 black Demon
